name: City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, February 18, 2014 - 07:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT
6.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Regular City Council Meeting held on February 3, 2014. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
Minutes- February 3, 2014
c.
Approval of Demands
Staff Report- item 6.C
d.
Approval to remove 32 feet of red curb from the east side of Pennsylvania Avenue between a point 198 feet and 230 feet south of the south curb line of Lomita Boulevard adjacent to the Arco Gasoline Station located at 2380 Lomita Boulevard. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff report- item 6.D
e.
Consideration of a Resolution of Intention and preparation of the Engineer's Report for Landscape Maintenance District No.1. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff Report- item 6.E
f.
Submittal of support letter to Darrell Stenberg, Senate Committee on Rules for the appointment of Judith Mitchell, Rolling Hills Estates Councilmember as SCAQMD Representative to the California Air Resources Board. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
Staff Report- item 6.F
g.
Final Acceptance of Eshelman Avenue Water Main Replacement and Street Resurfacing Project from PCH to Lomita Boulevard. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff Report- item 6.G
h.
Final Acceptance of Crenshaw Boulevard/Lomita Boulevard Intersection and Lomita Boulevard Pavement Rehabilitation Project (Phase 2). RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff Report- item 6.H
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
7.
DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO REPLACE A TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE AT NARBONNE AVENUE AND 243rd STREET
Discussion and possible direction to replace a traffic control device at the crosswalk intersection of Narbonne Avenue and 243rd Street and direct staff to procure equipment and vendors in the amount not to exceed $20,000. Presented by Community Services Department Director McPherron
Staff Report- item 7
ADJOURNMENT
Adjourn in memory of Norma Seller and William Tann.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
